cases.customer_question: What is the cost to obtain Bluetooth SIG qualification when rebranding and selling a purchased product under our own brand, including testing, certification, membership, and fees?
cases.actual_issue: The customer assumes a fixed cost for Bluetooth SIG qualification, but the required testing scope and cost depend on the specific Bluetooth design details (module/SoC, host stack, profiles) and whether existing qualified designs can be reused.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant explains that qualification cost cannot be determined without detailed information about the product’s Bluetooth implementation. The required test scope depends on the registered design elements such as module/SoC, host stack, and supported profiles. These factors determine whether testing is required or can be waived (e.g., reuse of existing qualified designs). The consultant also outlines the standard qualification workflow: SIG membership registration, test plan creation, sample testing and report generation, payment of qualification fees, submission/registration, and compliance folder delivery. A baseline cost is provided only for the scenario where all testing is exempted.
cases.final_recommendation: Collect and provide detailed Bluetooth design information (module/SoC, host stack, profiles) using a formal quotation request form so that the correct qualification path and cost (including potential test exemptions via design reuse) can be determined.
